(a) the B-L-violating sneutrino mass term is a generic feature of the soft SUSY breaking sector of any supersymmetric extension of the SM, (b) the B-L violating sneutrino mass is directly related to the neutrino mass, (c) this relation can be tested at colliders and (d) it can also be used to determine the neutrino mass.
